description: This PHP source file defines the DecodingEventStreamIterator class, which implements an iterator for decoding, validating, and extracting individual events from a binary-encoded AWS event stream. It includes methods for parsing headers, prelude, and event payloads, handling CRC validation, and utility functions for decoding various data types.

classes.name: DecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for decoding binary AWS event streams, validating integrity via CRC, and providing individual events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the iterator with a stream object and prepares the first event.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses the headers of an event from the stream based on the header length.

methods.name: parsePrelude
methods.description: Parses the prelude section of an event, including checksum validation.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Decodes an entire event from the stream, including headers, payload, and CRC validation.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next event, decoding it.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream and reinitializes the iterator to the first event.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Indicates if the current position points to a valid event within the stream bounds.
